column3: Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; NASB makes “your lips will observe knowledge” a purpose clause (“your lips may reserve knowledge”).
“A strange woman” is rendered “an adulteress,” and “her mouth” as “her speech.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Her end” is rendered “in the end she,” and “a sword of mouths” as “a two-edged sword.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Lest she should make level the path of life” is rendered “She does not ponder the path of life”; “they wander” is rendered “are unstable,” and NASB adds “it.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “Children” is rendered “sons.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “Lest” is rendered “Or,” and “a cruel [person]” as “the cruel one.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Your labor” is rendered “your hard-earned goods,” and NASB adds “will go.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Wastes away” is rendered “are consumed,” and “at your end” as “at your latter end.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Discipline” is rendered “instruction,” and “rebuke” as “reproof.”
Close to the Hebrew; The singular “my instructor” is rendered “my teachers,” and “my teachers” as “my instructors.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Like a little I was in every calamity” is rendered “I was almost in utter ruin.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Streams” is rendered “fresh water.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Will they overflow” is rendered “Should … be dispersed,” and “open places” as “streets.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “From the wife” is rendered “in the wife.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A doe of loves and a goat of grace” is rendered “a loving hind and a graceful doe,” and “be intoxicated” as “Be exhilarated.”
“Go astray (be intoxicated) with a strange woman” is rendered “be exhilarated with an adulteress,” and “a foreign woman” as “a foreigner.”
Close to the Hebrew; “He makes level all his tracks” is rendered “He watches all his paths.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “For not discipline” is rendered “for lack of instruction,” and “foolishness” as “folly.”
